# agent/verification-bypass

Git hooks skipped.

`git commit --no-verify` or `-n`, `git push --no-verify`, `HUSKY=0`, `LEFTHOOK=0`, or `SKIP=...` on git commands, changes to `core.hooksPath`, `pre-commit uninstall`, and edits to `.git/hooks/*`.

- Default level: `block`.
- Levels: Denied.
- Looks at: agent actions in hooks: commands, file reads, and prompts.
- References: [CWE-693](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/693.html), OWASP ASI02, OWASP ASI10.

## Why it matters

Git hooks run the project's checks, including Ubon. An agent that skips them to get a commit through ships exactly what the checks exist to stop.

## How to fix

Run the command without skipping hooks and fix what they report; if a hook is broken, tell the user.

## If the check is wrong

This check runs in agent hooks. Allow a command prefix with `commands.allow` in `ubon.json`, or set `"rules": { "agent/verification-bypass": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
